question: How many expert eruption forecasts from 1990–2013 turned out correct?
answer: A study checked what scientists had forecast for 190 eruptions between 1990 and 2013. Only about 1 forecast in 5 proved right, which is 19%. So there is still no single reliable way to say when a volcano will erupt.
move: Eruption forecasts were right only about 1 time in 5.

web.label: A grid of dots, one per volcanic eruption, under a hold-to-check button. Holding it reveals that only 19% of 190 expert eruption forecasts from 1990 to 2013 were correct.
